segments.name: Commercial kitchen equipment
segments.description: Designs, produces and sells stainless steel commercial kitchen equipment in China under its own Li Bang brand, with design and installation services.
segments.evidence: The main business of our Operating Subsidiaries is to design, develop, produce and sell stainless steel commercial kitchen equipment in China under our own "Li Bang" brand.

revenueModel.text: Customers such as hotels, companies, public institutions and hospitals pay for the kitchen equipment they buy; installation and after-sales services generate no separate revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: Our Operating Subsidiaries sell products and provide services under our own "Li Bang" brand, and our income comes from these sales, of which installation and after-sales services do not separately generate revenue.
